title: perf(mr): skip fetching the merge request when only its IID is needed
description:
## What does this MR do?

Commands that only use a merge request's IID or web URL no longer send `GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:iid`.

- Adds `mrutils.MRRefFromArgs`. For a branch lookup, it takes the IID and web URL from the list response. For an ID or URL argument, it sends no request and builds the web URL from the API base URL, keeping the subfolder, with the repository host.
- Adds `mrutils.MRNotFound`, which turns a 404 from the command's own request into `merge request !N not found in OWNER/REPO`.
- Moves these commands to the new resolver: `mr todo`, `mr issues`, `mr approvers`, `mr diff`, `mr note` (legacy), `mr note create|list|update|delete|resolve|reopen`, `mr note draft create|list|update|delete`. `mr note draft publish` still fetches the full MR because it reads the author and reviewers.
- `note create`, `draft create` and legacy `mr note` still fetch the MR before opening an editor or uploading `--attach` files. Without that, a missing MR would surface only after the user typed a comment or after an upload that can't be undone.
- Draft update and delete on a missing MR now say `pending review comment N not found, or merge request !N does not exist`, because the 404 can't tell which one is missing.

## Manual testing

Requests were logged through a local proxy, comparing a `main` build with this branch:

| Command | main | this MR |
|---|---|---|
| `mr issues` / `approvers` / `note list` / `note draft list` | GET MR + 1 | 1 |
| `mr diff` | GET MR + 2 | 2 |
| `mr note create` / `mr note -m` / `draft create` / `todo` | GET MR + 1 | 1 |
| `note update` / `resolve` / `reopen` / `delete`, `draft update` / `delete` | GET MR + 2 | 2 |
| branch argument | list + GET MR + 1 | list + 1 |
| `note create --attach` | GET MR + upload + create | same (fetch kept on purpose) |

A missing MR (`999999`) now reports `merge request !999999 not found in <repo>` instead of `failed to get merge request 999999: 404 Not Found`. Printed note URLs are correct for IID, branch, and URL arguments.

Tests use strict gomock clients, so any unexpected `GetMergeRequest` call fails.
